## Derivation

For every odd residue r modulo 2^k, I generated the accelerated trajectory directly. At each step e_j is the exact 2-adic valuation of 3x_(j-1)+1 and x_j=(3x_(j-1)+1)/2^e_j. In parallel I used A_0=1, B_0=0, D_0=1 and A_j=3A_(j-1), B_j=3B_(j-1)+D_(j-1), D_j=2^e_j D_(j-1). Exact integer checks over every enumerated prefix found D_j x_j=A_j r+B_j identically.

A prefix was retained exactly when k>=1+sum(e), A<D, and B<(D-A)r. These conditions gave the four valid-prefix totals stated above. The raw totals also follow independently from depthmax times the number of odd residues over k=2 through kmax, namely depthmax*(2^kmax-2).

The all-members implication is exact. If n=r+t2^k and the exponent sequence through step s is that of r, then after j-1 divisions the perturbation is divisible by 2^(k-E_(j-1)). Since k>=E_s+1, at step j the perturbation entering 3x+1 is divisible by at least 2^(e_j+1), so adding it cannot change the base numerator's exact valuation e_j. Induction preserves the full exponent sequence. Hence C^s(n)=(A_s n+B_s)/D_s, and because A_s<D_s and B_s<(D_s-A_s)r, one has (D_s-A_s)n-B_s>0 for every t>=0, so C^s(n)<n.

Using residue-class inclusion as the containment relation, a class (k,r) is redundant whenever an already retained coarser class (k0,r0) has k0<=k and r congruent to r0 modulo 2^k0. Increasing (k,r) reduction yields exactly the 23, 53, 107, and 306 counts and the reported per-modulus new-class splits. Projecting these classes to the relevant powers of two gives the coverage counts and the +330, +438, and +108 evaluator new-coverage increments stated above.

The stated empty-list compact-JSON hash fixes the bytes for an empty list only and does not determine the representation of nonempty rule objects.
